title: K-flat tensor homology at a stalk after a ring isomorphism
statement: Let Z be a ringed space, x a point, A a commutative ring and e:A≅O_Z,x a ring isomorphism. Fix a derived category of A-modules [def-pc-derived-category]. Let P be a K-flat cochain complex of O_Z-module sheaves [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Define S to be the actual module stalk functor [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] at x followed by restriction along e. For every O_Z-module sheaf F and integer i, the abelian-group stalk of H^i(Tot(P tensor F[0])) [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] is isomorphic to the underlying abelian group of H^i(Q(S(P)) tensor-derived S(F)[0]). There is no boundedness condition, and S(F) is a constructed module, not an arbitrary existence witness.

source.place: Tags 06YB, 08CG and 09U9; Modules Tag 01AG; derived tensor comparison as implemented by DerivedCategory.QObjTensorQObjIsoOfKFlatLeft in the source library.

proof.text: Apply isKFlat_iff_stalk_isKFlat to P and hP at x. This gives acyclicity of total tensor with the actual stalk complex for every acyclic complex over the stalk ring.

For a ring equivalence e:A≃B, specialize nonempty_tensorRestrictExtendScalarsIso to the second complex restricted along e. Restriction is fully faithful, so the counit of extendRestrictScalarsAdj is invertible. Lift that counit to complexes by mapHomologicalComplexCompIso and mapHomologicalComplexIdIso, apply tensor with the first complex, and compose its restricted inverse with the tensor identity. This proves Res(Tot(P tensor L))≅Tot(Res(P) tensor Res(L)). To transport K-flatness, lift an arbitrary acyclic A-complex through restriction along e inverse, apply stalk K-flatness, and restrict the resulting acyclic total tensor back along e. Compose the tensor comparison with the complex equivalence counit to return to the original test complex. Convert this acyclic-tensor criterion to categorical kFlat using kFlat_quotient_obj_iff and kFlat_iff_preserves_acyclic, with braiding supplying the other tensor order.

Use the exactness clause of module_stalk_exact with each short complex to prove that the module stalk functor preserves homology, via Functor.exact_tfae. Obtain finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation and compose with exact restriction of scalars. Assemble the complex isomorphism by applying restriction to exists_stalk_tensor_complex_iso, then the ring-equivalence tensor comparison, then singleMapHomologicalComplex on the second factor. Apply homologyFunctor.mapIso and prepend the inverse of ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso. This gives the ordinary transported stalk tensor homology isomorphism.

Apply QObjTensorQObjIsoOfKFlatLeft to the transported stalk of P and the degree-zero single of the transported F. Precompose with whiskerLeftIso of singleFunctorIsoCompQ. Apply degree-i derived homology to the inverse of this comparison, prepend the inverse of homologyFunctorFactors, and compose with the ordinary homology isomorphism from the previous step. Forget scalars to obtain the abelian-group isomorphism in the statement. The underlying abelian-group stalk agrees definitionally with forgetting the actual constructed stalk module.

lean.statement:
theorem stalk_kFlat_tensor_homology_iso
    (Z : RingedSpace.{u}) (x : Z) (A : CommRingCat.{u})
    (e : A ≅ Z.presheaf.stalk x)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z)) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := Z.sheaf) P) :
    let S := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Z x ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars e.hom.hom
    ∀ (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z)) (i : ℤ),
      Nonempty ((TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u} Z.carrier ⋙
        TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).obj
          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj
            ((CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P
              ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj F)
              (@MonoidalCategory.curriedTensor _ _
                (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory Z.sheaf))).homology i)) ≅
        (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} A) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((S.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ⊗
              (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (S.obj F))))
